$comment: Claude Code enhancement layer (L2) for the config-driven loop harness. Stack-specific behavior comes entirely from .harness.json in the project root (source_globs, blocked_command_patterns, commands.*) — nothing here is TS/Bun/React-specific. PLAN phase (role=orchestrator, human-approved tasks.json) then autonomous LOOP phase (role=implement, one bounded task per run). Determinism = binary gates wired to lifecycle events; safety = PreToolUse guards (no human to approve prompts during unattended runs).

PreToolUse.$comment: Orchestrator (PLAN) must not write source; implementer (LOOP) may. Role decides.
Force Bun; block other PMs and destructive commands. This is the safety net for unattended runs.

PostToolUse.$comment: G1 fast per-file feedback (non-blocking): eslint --fix + prettier on the touched file.

SubagentStop.$comment: If a task run fans out to subagents, gate each one. typecheck + lint + scoped vitest. exit 2 = keep working.

Stop.$comment: Role-dispatched. implement => scoped task gate (force-continue until green). orchestrator/interactive => global gate. plan => tasks.json sanity only.
